verdict.rationale: Evidence only documents Pulumi's own MCP server (pulumi-docs-7, pulumi-docs-18, pulumi-docs-26) which lets external AI assistants like Claude/Cursor call Pulumi's tools — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Pulumi itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows Pulumi, Pulumi AI, or Neo acting as an MCP client connecting to third-party MCP servers.
